name: Prod deploy + live SEO gate
command: for i in $(seq 1 40); do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -L --max-time 20 https://octavlearning.com/igcse); echo "check $i: /igcse -> $code"; if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then sleep 30; npm run build:static >/tmp/prod-build.log 2>&1 && npm run verify:seo:live -- --all; exit $?; fi; sleep 60; done; echo "PROD /igcse NOT LIVE after 40 checks"; exit 1
